column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Golgotha prologue (gender variants)
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Among the $$罪$$s in this $$世界$$,
one of the $$七つの大罪$$ is considered the gravest $$罪$$:
a girl who uttered $$愛$$...
a $$ご主人様$$ who uttered $$愛$$...
was taken away somewhere by the $$異端審問官$$s.
With your $$記憶$$ gone,
and having lost the one who was your whole $$世界$$,
you stood at the brink of despair.
Branded a $$反抗奴隷$$,
you were marched off to the gloomy prison called $$ゴルゴダ$$.
This place would be
the turning point that would chart your harsh fate—
though you had no idea it would change your life...
